_about: Public-domain John of Kronstadt (John Iliytch Sergieff, 1829-1908, archpriest of St Andrew's Cathedral, Kronstadt) in English for the Word Hoard: My Life in Christ, extracts from his diary translated with the author's sanction by E. E. Goulaeff (London: Cassell, 1897), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 27 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

kronstadt-my-life-in-christ: My Life in Christ, extracts from the diary of John Iliytch Sergieff (Father John) of Cronstadt, tr. E. E. Goulaeff (London: Cassell, 1897)
